name: grant-eligibility-advisor
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent with a custom MCP server and an interactive MCP App widget. Hand-authored, no Agents Toolkit.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix src/server install && npm --prefix src/widget install
scripts.build: npm run validate:data && npm run build:widget && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix src/widget run typecheck && npm --prefix src/server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build && cd src\server && node --import tsx --test ..\..\tests\*.test.mjs
